# Page Comparison Analysis

## 1) Heading position/size
- **Heading "הקדמה"**: Present on both, centered, same position vertically (~upper-middle of page after top margin) and same large bold size. ✔ Match
- **"בתקופתנו..." catch-heading line**: Same bold style and placement beneath the main heading on both sides. ✔ Match

## 2) Opening ornament/decoration
- No visible decorative ornament (rules, frames, or flourishes) on either side — this layout uses typography only. Both sides are consistent (no ornament in either). ✔ Match

## 3) Body text layout
- Single-column layout on both sides (no two-column division on this page). ✔ Match
- Line breaks and paragraph divisions match paragraph-for-paragraph; line count per paragraph is essentially the same, with minor line-break differences mid-paragraph (e.g., right column slightly wider on the new engine, causing a few words to shift lines). Minor, cosmetic.
- Running header: both show "בראשית" and "פרשת..." in header; the old engine shows three header items (בראשית / הפטרה / פרשת) vs two on the right (בראשית / פרשת). The middle "הפטרה" item is missing on the new engine. ⚠ Small difference.
- Catchword/folio mark "סה" at bottom present on both. ✔ Match

## 4) Window word (large first word in margin)
- The large first word "בתקופתנו" appears inline at the start of the first paragraph in bold on both sides — same treatment, no marginal window word on either. ✔ Match
- Other emphasized openings ("והנה", "ובפרק ב'") appear identically in both. ✔ Match

## 5) Overall parity
Layout, typography, emphasis, indentation of the closing blessing paragraph ("אשריכם..."), and page furniture all correspond. Only deviations: missing middle header item and trivial line-break shifts.

## Verdict: DIFFERENCES
- Header: middle entry "הפטרה" present on OLD, absent on NEW.
- Minor line-break/line-count shifts within paragraphs (cosmetic).

Everything else (heading, ornament policy, single-column body, window word, page number) is in parity; fix the header middle item to reach full parity.
